name: Burgos (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided red over brown, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of the city of Burgos (the bust of the king on red, with supporters and mantle).
history: The flag of Burgos is composed of two horizontal stripes of the same width, the upper red and the lower brown, with the arms of the city centred on it; although of medieval origin, the flag breaks the rules of heraldry by placing colour on colour, an unusual exception among medieval flags.

features.role: Burgos arms — bust of the king on red, with supporters
